summary: T-0184 closes the residual BYPASSRLS read gap in queryGrantTrail (src/db/audit-grant-trail.ts): adds explicit `tenant_id = $2` to the SQL conditions array, mirroring the T-0141 org.ts pattern. New pool-role fitness test (ci/checks/db/grant-trail-pool-role.test.ts) uses choros_migrator (BYPASSRLS) to prove AC-2 cross-tenant isolation and AC-3 self-test (raw SELECT without WHERE sees TENANT_B rows — confirming fix is load-bearing). Static check grant-trail-bypassrls-predicate.sh wired into npm run fitness. Nit R-1 closed: grep anchor changed from comment-matching WHERE pattern to backtick-string `tenant_id = $N` (planted-file-without-condition now correctly goes RED). npm run ci: 1107/1107 passed. fitness:db T-0184 tests: 2/2 PASS. 5 pre-existing DB failures unrelated to this task.

residual_risks.description: Runtime read pool remains choros_migrator (BYPASSRLS). Explicit WHERE tenant_id = $2 is the primary guard; RLS provides defence-in-depth only on NOBYPASSRLS connections. The structural fix (APP_DATABASE_URL = choros_app, NOBYPASSRLS) is the Stage-2 candidate, blocked on runtime config split.
residual_risks.follow_up_candidate: Split DATABASE_URL into APP_DATABASE_URL (choros_app, NOBYPASSRLS) + MIGRATOR_DATABASE_URL — previously tracked as T-0022; makes RLS the primary guard and WHERE tenant_id defence-in-depth for all read paths.

promote_guide.merge_mode: auto — orchestrator (D-053) rebases+merges feature branch into dev after all gates pass
promote_guide.no_migrations: T-0184 adds no SQL migrations, no DDL changes, no known_tenant_tables.txt changes. Pure application-layer fix (SQL query text + fitness test + static check).
promote_guide.no_gotchas: No sibling-frozen-file false-positives expected. No role-criticality-isolation false-positive (no known_tenant_tables.txt change). All fitness checks green on branch.
promote_guide.downstream_effect: queryGrantTrail now carries explicit WHERE tenant_id = $2 on all pool paths. Additive (redundant-but-correct on NOBYPASSRLS). Unblocks Stage-2: APP_DATABASE_URL split can proceed knowing the application layer is already hardened.

stage2_candidate.name: APP_DATABASE_URL split — NOBYPASSRLS runtime pool
stage2_candidate.description: Create APP_DATABASE_URL env var pointing to choros_app (NOBYPASSRLS) for all read/write application paths; keep DATABASE_URL / MIGRATOR_DATABASE_URL for migration runner only. With this split, RLS becomes the primary cross-tenant guard and the explicit WHERE tenant_id clauses become defence-in-depth. The existing pool-role fitness test (grant-trail-pool-role.test.ts) will need to update its migratorUrl() pool to appUrl() to reflect the new runtime role.
stage2_candidate.blocked_on: Runtime config split (APP_DATABASE_URL env var), server restart, and update of all pool constructors in src/ to select app vs migrator URL by context.
